about: Foods and recipe ingredients for fueling suggestions. Nutrient values are per 100 g exactly as USDA FoodData Central gives them (SR Legacy, looked up 2026-11-22 and 2026-11-23), with the FDC ID and description for each. Branded foods come from the maker's label instead (read 2026-11-23), scaled from the label serving to 100 g, with the brand, page, label values, ingredients and allergen statement in source. Serving sizes say where they came from: an FDC portion weight, the label serving, or a common household measure set by the app. FDC has no allergen data: contains and may_contain are filled from the food itself for single ingredient foods, and from the label's contains and may contain text for branded foods. allergens_checked is true only for those, plain dairy, and labels where both the ingredients and allergen statement were read. Mixed foods stay unchecked until a labelled product is added. A null nutrient means the source has no value for it.
